blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The revamped Capital1 roster may not have lived up to high expectations after missing the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series semifinals, but Vanie Gandler remains committed to trusting the process. The Solar Spikers were already eliminated from Final Four contention before their game after PLDT’s four-set win over Galeries Tower. Capital1, however, continued to fight before falling to Farm Fresh, 25-17, 25-21, 23-25, 25-23, on Saturday night at Philsports Arena. This isn’t what we’ve hoped for, but then, we said in the start that we’re still a new team, and we’re gonna have to trust the process, […]...
